summary: Banco Santander, S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting daily open-market repurchases under its previously announced Board-approved Buyback Programme. Between 1 and 7 October 2026 the bank bought 21,600,000 ordinary shares across XMAD, CEUX, TQEX and AQEU at weighted average prices of roughly EUR 11.75 to EUR 12.47 per share, lifting cumulative cash spent to EUR 1,175,196,981, about 64.4% of the programme's maximum investment amount, and roughly 18.5% of shares outstanding as of 2021. No advisor or recommendation was named. Watch remaining capacity and pace of execution.
